title: Beachy Keen Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: This luxurious Gulf-front condo offers an exquisite retreat at Seacrest Beach, presenting an ideal blend of comfort and sophistication within the exclusive, gated beachfront community of High Pointe. Freshly introduced to the market following a comprehensive renovation, this abode features an all-suite bedroom/bathroom configuration, cutting-edge appliances, and refined accommodations that elevate the vacation experience. From the vantage of your private fourth-floor balcony, indulge in the panoramic views of the Gulf and beach, promising unforgettable sunsets and serene moments. The interior is a haven for culinary enthusiasts, boasting a gourmet full kitchen designed for crafting chef-inspired meals, complemented by a large dining island and an adjacent table for communal dining. The living area, adorned with a smart TV and plush seating, further enhances the allure with additional views of the Gulf, creating a perfect setting for family gatherings, all while a brand-new air-conditioner maintains a cool and comfortable ambiance.
